anchor: first seeded geometry-valid anchor admitting the fixed pose count
poses: same shared geometry-only menu for every source in a scene
source_set: all historical split sources; no visibility/distance/acoustic-success filtering
split: preserve historical scene-disjoint train/val/test; new observations in previously exposed test scenes are supplemental
failure: fail scene explicitly; never remove individual source-specific actions
outputs: four physical point microphones, measured raycast XYZ and separate labels
